bearingSource: OSM way 267207998 long axis 123.5°; +X points ESE to the narrowing apse end of the outline, the wide porch block with the main door faces −X (drone photo 03, ground photo 02)
approximations: Only three small third-party images (not publishable): a ground view of the west front (02), a drone view of the courtyard (03) and a distant valley view (01). Layout from the photos, clarified by ro.wikipedia (triconch plan, three towers over the porch, the pronaos and the naos): enclosed porch ≈ 16 × 13.4 m with ≈ 6 m walls, pronaos/naos body ≈ 9.4 m wide with ≈ 10 m walls, three octagonal drums on cross-gabled square bases with shallow octagonal eave roofs and small round domes. Heights estimated without survey data (crosses ≈ 14.4, 22.4 and 23.4 m). The east end, lateral conchs and polygonal apse are not photographed and follow the OSM outline and the typical triconch layout; buttresses omitted. The photographs show the church with a light grey sheet roof (the drone photo shows new copper only on the precinct wings); the copper finish of the church follows the project record and is not confirmed by the photographs. Ensemble: the precinct ranges whose roofs show new copper in drone photo 03 are included at low detail — the north range and the angled north-east range (meeting at a mitred bend; walls ≈ 6 m, 26° gables), the two-storey south range (walls ≈ 8 m, 28° gable) with the copper pavilion at its east end and a short southern projection; plan positions from the OSM precinct outlines (ways 1432713919, 1432717713/14) converted to the model frame, heights estimated from photo 03. The west entrance range, the east range, the round corner towers and the outer buildings show grey (zinc) roofs in that photo and are omitted, except the tower at the north bend and the pavilion at the north-east end, which are kept as plain neutral massing; the double roof of the north range, window rows and roof vents are simplified.

note.ro: Machetă preliminară după trei fotografii mici și conturul OSM: înălțimile sunt estimate, iar capătul estic și absidele laterale sunt interpretate. Fotografiile arată biserica cu o învelitoare gri; finisajul de cupru urmează evidența proiectului. Sunt incluse, simplificat, și aripile incintei care poartă același cupru în fotografia cu drona: aripa de nord, aripa de nord-est și aripa de sud cu pavilionul de colț.
note.hu: Előzetes makett három kis fotó és az OSM-körvonal alapján: a magasságok becsültek, a keleti rész és az oldalapszisok értelmezettek. A fotókon a templom szürke fedésű; a rézfelület a projektnyilvántartást követi. Egyszerűsítve a kerítés szárnyai is szerepelnek, amelyeken a drónfotó ugyanazt a rezet mutatja: az északi, az északkeleti és a déli szárny a sarokpavilonnal.
note.en: Preliminary scale model based on three small photographs and the OSM outline: heights are estimated, and the east end and lateral apses are interpreted. The photographs show the church with a grey roof; the copper finish follows the project record. The precinct ranges that carry the same copper in the drone photograph are included in simplified form: the north and north-east ranges and the south range with its corner pavilion.
